sphere_directions: independent normal vectors normalized to unit Euclidean length
candidate_retention: first four failed points in completed-batch order; retain all measured rows in evidence
stopping: initialization cap or fixed total budget; reject a whole batch before sampling if it does not fit
formal_denominator: only completed estimation rows; exclude initialization and recheck
missing_estimates: report separately; never replace with zero
scope: project-defined two-dimensional mechanism study; not a paper reproduction or SRAM validation
